I am Phoebe, a graduate of the Department of Applied English at Ming Dao University, with over five yearsof
experience in international trade and overseas sales within the bicycle industry.
My responsibilities include customer inquiries, quotations, sample arrangements, order and delivery follow-ups,
shipment arrangements, and after-sales service. I amfamiliar with the entire order process from order
placement to shipment.
Additionally, I am experienced in preparing shipping documents, reviewing L/C terms, and working with freight
forwarders, customs brokers, and banks. I also collaborate with R&D, production planning, and quality control teams
to meet customer requirements and monitor projects from sampling to mass production.
I have participated in several domestic and international trade exhibitionsand am skilled in customer
relationship management, cross-functional collaboration, and project management.
I am detail-oriented and proactive in resolving issues, and look forward to applying my experience in new industries
while maintaining customer relationships and ensuring smooth order fulfillment.
